parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `DebugMetricsProvider` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — carries `is_sample_app: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a sample-app-marked record must default to no-action to avoid coupling production code to demonstration semantics. The canonical production definition already lives in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`, `is_sample_app: false`); the sample-app copy in `WallpaperSampleApp` is a self-contained local duplicate that exists deliberately so the sample app can run without a hard dependency on the `DebugPanel` package. The only structural difference — `metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?` — is a minor existential-syntax variant consistent with an independently maintained copy, not evidence of a shared abstraction worth extracting.
